display_long_description:
**Referee full 11v11 football matches in VR, then live the same match from 11 more roles.**

**Made for VR.** Show the card with your own hand, strike the ball by moving your hands like your feet and raise the camera to your eye: you live the whole match with your body.
[media]

**REFEREE:** call fouls, play advantage and show cards with your own hand. Fair or corrupt, you decide.
[media]

**VAR:** rewind, check every camera, draw the offside line.
[media]

**ASSISTANT:** run the line and raise the flag.

**FOURTH OFFICIAL:** substitution board, added time, both benches.
[media]

**PLAYER:** use your hands as your feet to strike the ball.
[media]

**GOALKEEPER:** set the wall, catch crosses, punch corners clear.
[media]

**COACH:** tactics and subs, then face the press.
[media]

**PHOTOGRAPHER:** 600 mm lenses and bursts to land the front page.
[media]

**MEDIC:** catch the fakers, treat injuries, drive the stretcher cart.
[media]

**COMMENTATOR:** call the match live from the booth.
[media]

**FAN:** drums, flares, paper planes and pitch invasions.

**FULL STADIUMS:** clubs and national teams inspired by real football, referee career, leagues and cups.

**ONLINE:** up to 48 people in the same match on PC and Quest, each in their own role; the AI fills the rest. Updates every few days.
